facts.big: I was cooking when the phone rang.
facts.label: Past progressive + when
facts.sub: Use was/were + verbo-ing para a ação longa e o passado simples depois de when para o evento que a interrompeu.

facts.label: Ação em andamento
facts.sub: Use was/were + verbo-ing para a ação que estava em andamento: I was cooking dinner. Use was com I, he, she e it. Use were com you, we e they.

facts.label: O que interrompe
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o evento curto, depois de when: when the phone rang. O evento mostra o momento exato em que a cena mudou.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: When can introduce the short event in the past.
We say “I cooked when the phone was ringing” for an interrupted action.
items.why: Better: I was cooking when the phone rang.

items.s: Was and were are used in the past progressive.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: When can introduce the short event in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I cooked when the phone was ringing” for an interrupted actio… → Falso (Better: I was cooking when the phone rang.)
Was and were are used in the past progressive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A busy kitchen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot evening in a kitchen in Phoenix. Luisa stirs the sauce with a big spoon. A smell of onions fills the room. Her phone is on the table, next to a bowl. Her friend Bo comes in with a worried face. He wants to know why she did not answer.
“Luisa, I called you at six. Why didn’t you answer?” says Bo. “I was cooking dinner when the phone rang, but my hands were wet.” says Luisa. “Ah, I see. What were you making?” says Bo.

paragraphs: “You were! I was opening a window when you called.” says Luisa. “Sorry, Luisa! Next time I will send a message.” says Bo. Luisa puts the soup on the table.
